email.body1:
Deniz, saw NetBrain just shipped Agentic NetOps with AI agents and a new MCP Server under your new CEO.

A wave of launches throws off expansion and intent signals, but most sales ops teams cannot route them to action fast enough before they go cold. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, 3-5x more meetings per rep without new headcount.

I built a signal play for NetBrain off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Deniz, quick follow-up for NetBrain.

The lag between a buying signal firing and a rep acting on it is usually where measurable lift hides, and it is hard to see from inside the funnel. Closing that latency is one of the fastest ways to move reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Deniz, last bit of proof for NetBrain.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain reply rate likely compares to other network-software vendors. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Deniz, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into pipeline faster is not on the sales ops roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. A new-CEO launch cycle is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to NetBrain either way.
